inputs.text: Vertical cinematic medium shot inside a modern Chinese apartment study at evening. Adult Chinese woman age 28 with oval face, dark brown almond eyes, straight black hair in a neat low ponytail, light blue button-up shirt, dark charcoal gray blazer and thin silver necklace sits at a wooden desk beside an open laptop. A smartphone lies on the desk and appears to vibrate. Her right hand is reaching toward it, eyebrows slightly drawn together.
